### Update Active Directory OUs

#### Description

Updates the Active Directory OUs with the specified payload.

#### Request

- **Method:** PATCH
    
- **URL:** {{host_url}}/api/v2/organizational_units
    
- **Headers:**
    

| Name | **Value** | **Required** | **Description** |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Accept | application/json | Yes | Type of response the client accepts. |
| Content-Type | application/json | Yes | Type of the data client posts to server. |
| Authorization |  | Yes | Authorization for the API Request |

- **Parameters**:
    

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| from | Integer | Yes | The starting index for pagination. |
| limit | Integer | Yes | The maximum number of records to retrieve for modification. |
| domain | String | Yes | Domain Name from which the object should be fetched. |
| sort | String | No | Comma-separated list of fields to sort by (\`-\` for descending order). |
| filter | String | No | The filter criteria to apply for retrieving specific user data. |
| refresh | Boolean | No | Boolean value to trigger sync prior fetching results |

- **Request body**
    

| Key | Type | **Required** | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| data | JSONObject | Yes | An JSONObject containing the object data to be updated. The object can include general attributes, exchange attributes details to be updated for the object. |

#### **Sample Request :**

```
curl --location --request PATCH 'localhost:8010/api/v2/organizational_units?limit=100&from=1&filter=name eq TestOU1&sort=OU_NAME&domain=xcross.com' \
--header 'Accept: application/json' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--header 'Authorization: 6077bcad-6d97-4e34-9780-23242d9da205' \
--data '{
    "data": {
        "attributes": {
            "name": "BulkUser10000",

            "managedBy": "pavi",
            "co": "India",
            "extensionAttribute1": "Targery",

}'
 ```
